history.summary: The headline 'cheapness' is almost certainly a data/labeling quirk: a 1,248 sqft unit tagged '2-bed' at $1,322 psf is really a 3BR/penthouse/row-house format, and its PSF is structurally low for that reason — actual Sant Ritz transactions run $1,742-$2,051 psf. Thin cohort (3 txns) plus a bedroom_sqft_mismatch flag mean the algo's -31.7% discount is unreliable.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,322 psf is ~30% below the verified project transaction range of $1,742-$2,051 psf (avg ~$1,850), which is too large to be a genuine bargain on a 2016 leasehold next to Potong Pasir MRT — it almost certainly reflects a large-format unit (Sant Ritz 3BR penthouses are 1,323-1,420 sqft; a comparable 3BR transacted at $1,894 psf for 1,098 sqft) whose strata area includes void/PES/roof space, mechanically deflating PSF. The bedroom_sqft_mismatch red flag and psf_cohort_txns of just 3 confirm the comp is statistically unsafe. Without verifying the exact floor plan, the -31.7% age_adj_premium and -27.0% cohort premium are likely artifacts, not value. Location (1-min walk Potong Pasir MRT, D13) is genuinely good, which keeps this Neutral rather than Avoid.
